messages:
Marta: Found a mystery Tupperware in the office fridge. No name on it. If it's yours, claim by 5pm or it's going communal :eyes: pic: https://imgur.com/abcd1234
Kai: Uh-oh. Smells like a story. :nose:
Josh: Vote: should we 1) open now, 2) wait till end of day, 3) donate to communal snack pile? React with :one:/:two:/:three:
Rebecca: Putting :two: — don't wanna start a biohazard incident before standup
Asha: There's a tiny sticky under the shelf that says "maybe ben?" but Ben's out today. Could be from last week's meetup
Marta: Also quick poll — what's your guess inside? 1) Salad 2) Curry 3) Mystery protein/surprise
Kai: I'm placing my vote on :three: for dramatic effect
Josh: I'm brave. I'll open it at 5 if still there. Whoever opens, take pics first. :camera_with_flash:
LunchBot: Reminder set for 17:00 to ping this thread if item still present.
Rebecca: Also agree we should put a label-station by the fridge. Cheap sticker roll and a Sharpie? :pencil2:
Asha: I'll bring adhesive labels tomorrow morning. Might save future archaeological digs.
Marta: Update: Asha confirmed it's not hers. Josh, if you end up opening, be prepared with napkins and heroic music.
Josh: Noted. Choosing heroic music playlist now. :headphones:
LunchBot: If unclaimed at 17:15, item will be moved to compost/communal table as per kitchen policy.
Marta: Thanks all. Thread closed after claim/compost.
